column3: MT 30:3. “to bind himself with a binding obligation” renders “to bind an obligation (issar) on his soul,” and “violate” renders “profane.”
MT 30:5. “says nothing” renders “keeps silent” (also in verses 7, 11 and 14).
MT 30:7. “if she should marry” renders an emphatic doubled verb, “being she should be to a husband,” and “the rash statement” renders “mivta,” a rash utterance (also in verse 8).
MT 30:10. “shall stand against her” renders “shall stand on her.”
MT 30:13. “indeed annuls” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 30:14. “to humble herself” renders “to afflict the soul.”
MT 30:15. “indeed says nothing” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
MT 30:16. “indeed annuls” renders an emphatic doubled verb, and “her guilt” renders “her iniquity.”
